title: La Ligne Verte
summary: A Telegram chatbot, with WhatsApp planned, where residents report trash-filled areas and earn points, with bonus points for cleaning them up. Every report feeds an open data map.
description: Greenpill Côte d'Ivoire presented La Ligne Verte as its Green Mission 2025 in Gitcoin Grants. A beta version runs on Telegram, and the project won a UNDP Côte d'Ivoire hackathon on AI and biodiversity protection, which partly funds it. Next steps include storing data in a smart contract and launching the first field actions.
